verdicts.reason: A holds a clean shared left edge (logo, headline, subhead and pills all at x≈131) and its spacing is even. Its flaws are the CTA, which floats on the right between the subhead and the flavour pills and breaks the reading order, and the lower-right area, which feels empty. B's headline is oversized and runs to within about 30px of the right edge. Its left edges don't match (the headline starts at x≈64, everything else at x≈76), and its bulky CTA crowds the subhead, so the layout looks cramped and unaligned.
